concerns.text: The human study data (`data/human_study_responses.csv`) is the dataset carrying the study's dependent variables, yet no recruitment platform, collection instrument, or data source is named anywhere — FR-006/Phase 2 reference a 'recruitment-platform API' and 'consent workflow files' without identifying which platform or where those files come from. Name the concrete recruitment/collection resource (or state explicitly that it is to-be-selected with selection criteria) so the data provenance of the outcome variables is anchored.
